summary: WF Card Funding LLC and WF Card Issuance Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered asset-backed securities offering. The issuing entity will issue $1.25 billion Class A(2026-1) notes at 4.08% interest, priced at 99.98598% of par, with underwriting discount of $3.125 million. Proceeds to the issuer are approximately $1.2467 billion. The notes are secured by credit card receivables and are obligations solely of the trust. The transaction is a routine shelf takedown of structured notes, not a special situation. No activism, M&A, or restructuring is involved.
